subject: Request: temporary capacity voucher for POC scaling run
messages:
From: Kate Huang <kate@novalabs.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC scaling run — request for temporary capacity voucher

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Nova Labs is lined up to run a 72-hour soak to validate end-to-end throughput and latency for our search summarization microservice. To make the test realistic we plan to:
- Ramp to 500 concurrent sessions within the first 6 hours
- Target sustained ~200k tokens/hour for 48–72 hours
- Run against the hosted API (region: us-west) with fallbacks to dedicated pools if needed

Can Redwood provide a temporary capacity voucher or trial top-up to cover the expected token usage so we can run the soak without hitting quota limits? We don’t need a contractual change — just a one-time supplement to the trial credits and a short extension window (7–10 days) so we can schedule the window.

Attached is our lightweight POC-plan.xlsx (traffic profile + ramp schedule).

Appreciate quick confirmation — we want to kick off the run on Mon May 18.

Best,
Kate Huang
Head of Integrations, Nova Labs
kate@novalabs.ai

Attachments: POC-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Kate Huang <kate@novalabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scaling run — request for temporary capacity voucher

Hi Kate — thanks for the plan and the clear ramp profile. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary top-up for the soak. I need to lock down a few details before we finalize the allocation:

1) Do you want the supplement as hosted credits (fastest) or should we reserve a short Dedicated burst for the run?
2) Confirm region (you referenced us-west) and whether you’ll need a hard SLA for latency during the window.
3) Requested tokens/credits estimate (I can provision in tokens or USD-equivalent credits).

Proposed provision: we can do a provisional voucher equivalent to $7,500 in hosted credits plus a 10-day trial extension pending final approval from billing. If you confirm the token estimate and region, I’ll loop in Marissa (billing approvals) and Rishi (security/compliance signoff) to make it live.

If Monday the 18th is the desired start, please confirm today so we can get credit allocation ready.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Looping in Jordan for allocation. Quick internal note for the thread:

- Trial extension: +10 days from original trial expiry.
- Condition: run must be non-production (POC) and logs retained for 30 days for audit.

Rishi — please confirm there are no outstanding security requirements before we provision (SOC2 evidence is current; see attached approval-note.pdf). Jordan, once cleared, please apply voucher to account DEAL-9421 and send access instructions.

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-05-17T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Allocation: Nova Labs provisional voucher applied

Hi all — per Marissa’s approval I’ve applied the hosted credit voucher to DEAL-9421. Details below: 
- Voucher: one-time hosted credit = $7,500 (token-equivalent)
- Trial extended by 10 days (expiry now 2027-05-28)
- Region: us-west (applied to account region scope)

Access steps (sent to customer also):
1) Log into Console > Billing > Credits. Voucher shows as 'POC-SUPPORT-9421'.
2) If you expect to hit capacity limits on a single host, toggle the 'Auto-fallback to Dedicated' option in App Settings and open a runtime ticket.
3) If you need a dedicated burst, raise a ticket with subject 'DEAL-9421 – Dedicated burst request'.

I’ve attached a short text file with the console steps (access-instructions.txt) and flagged the account for monitoring during the 72-hour window. Priya — please confirm we’ve passed the security checks and then I’ll mark the allocation final.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference
